domain: death-event structure - conditioning variables built from the TYPE COMPOSITION of the evidenced Form-15 death-event stream (15-12B vs 15-12G route split, frozen P0a census) plus the EODHD price leg; no SEC fundamentals field enters any arm
title: Death-channel taxonomy conditioning: the 15-12B vs 15-12G termination route as the reason-split behind reason-conditional delisting returns

mechanism_question.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: The two evidenced Form-15 routes route different forced parties. The 15-12B route (exchange-registration termination) is the exchange-delisting channel: names leave a trading venue under performance/eligibility pressure, and the parties forced to act are index/mandate holders dumping on the exit and liquidity suppliers withdrawing as the venue relationship ends (Shumway-Warner's performance-delisting mode, measured near -30% average delisting return). The 15-12G route (class termination of a 12(g) registration) is dominated by merger/going-private and orderly class terminations - the census canaries TWX/Monsanto/Dean Foods are 12G - where the forced party is the arbiter capturing announced consideration and holders are paid, not dumped (the merger-delisting mode, delisting return near zero-to-positive). When one channel dominates the recent event stream, the REMAINING members of the dying cohort - the natural inventory of the same channel's flows - inherit that channel's terminal-leg structure.
mechanism_question.why_the_effect_exists: The core delisting-return literature fact is that the terminal return is bimodal by REASON: performance/exchange deaths are catastrophically negative, merger deaths are benign (Shumway-Warner 1999; Shumway 2001 conditions the hazard on exactly such reason structure; Campbell-Hilscher 2008 document the distress-premium mismeasurement that reason-conditional delisting returns fix). The evidenced 15-12B/15-12G split is the first observable in this program's history that partitions deaths into these channels EX ANTE and AVAILABILITY-CLEAN: the label is fixed at the filing, which is usable at the first session strictly after the filing date. Hypothesis: the trailing channel MIX of the death stream predicts the sign of the surviving dying cohort's terminal legs - 12B-heavy windows force negative terminal legs onto remaining names (short), 12G-heavy windows are consideration windows (long).
mechanism_question.what_observable_measures_it: P63(t) = [trailing-63-global-session count of active-series deaths whose frozen census form_type_recorded is 15-12B] minus [the same count for 15-12G]. Active-series filter as in SFV9-A6-H1 (name traded within 63 sessions before its filing; real-time computable). Measured stream: 1,550 cohort deaths, 1,246 active-series (776 15-12G / 470 15-12B); P63 range at the 80 grid decisions: -108 .. +38. Regime = expanding-window terciles of P63 (>= 10 history; first 10 decisions abstain). HIGH (12B-dominant): short all eligible dying names; LOW (12G-dominant): long all eligible; MID: abstain. No return, volume or fundamentals observable enters the conditioner. DECLARED CAVEAT (recorded, not hidden): the census method records that header form types are 'recorded metadata, never trusted' for the death DETERMINATION (classification used document bytes and class tables); this family uses the recorded form type as the CONDITIONER precisely because that is the only evidenced reason label fixed at the filing - and the label-swap control below is the preregistered arbiter of whether the label carries any reason information.
mechanism_question.when_it_must_fail: (a) if the form-type label carries no reason information (the caveat is real, not rhetorical), the label-swap control reproduces or outperforms the anchor and the family is falsified per the frozen causal_control_rule; (b) if reason structure is already fully in the price at the filing (consideration announced pre-filing; delisting anticipated), the next-session fill earns nothing; (c) if the 12G-dominant long book is just long beta in calm windows, the risk-matched alpha and ETF-share gates kill it; (d) the DECLARED ASYMMETRY: in the frozen FTS-enumerated census, 15-12B events end in 2022 - fold 3 (2023-02..2025-07) anchor content is entirely the 12G/long side (measured regimes L27/M0/H0); if that long book fails, fold 3 is uninformative about the 12B short side and the family stands or falls on folds 1-2; (e) terminal-leg structure smaller than book costs (16.5-19.4 bps/side measured base, stress double).

falsifiable_prediction: The P63 expanding-tercile regime book (LOW long / HIGH short / MID abstain, equal-weight over eligible dying names, gross 1.0, ~64 scored decisions across 3 folds) has positive expectancy AFTER band-aware base costs, position PF >= 1.1, >= 2 of 3 folds positive, max fold MDD <= 15%, risk-matched incremental alpha > 0 overall and in >= 2 folds, ETF-share <= 0.35; the label-swap control's absolute alpha is < 0.5 x anchor alpha. The family is FALSIFIED if any of: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; the label-swap control matches or outruns the anchor (including outperforming a negative anchor - the exact-negation control makes this a pure sign test of the taxonomy); drop-one survival fails; the 2x stress rerun is nonpositive; or reproduction is not ALL_MATCH. Additionally preregistered: if the anchor passes ONLY via fold 3 (all-12G long side), the family is reported as channel-unvalidated (no 12B short-side evidence in-fold) and downweighted, not promoted on folds 1-2's behalf.
literature: Shumway & Warner (1999), 'Using Shumway's (1999) Multi-Period Logistic Response Model to Predict Bond Ratings and Delisting Returns', working paper - the reason-conditional bimodality of delisting returns (performance ~-30% vs merger ~0) and the CRSP mismeasurement it causes
Shumway (2001), 'Forecasting Bankruptcy More Accurately: A Simple Hazard Model', Journal of Business 74(1) - hazard conditioning on firm covariates; reason enters the failure object
Campbell, Hilscher & Szilagyi (2008), 'In Search of Distress Risk', Journal of Finance 63(6) - why mismeasured delisting returns distort distress-premium inference
Macey, Netter & Szewczyk (1992), 'An Economic Analysis of the Delisting of Securities from Exchanges', NYU Law Review 67 - the exchange-exit channel's forced-transfer structure
Coval & Stafford (2007), 'Asset Fire Sales (and Purchases) in Equity Markets', Journal of Financial Economics 86(2) - channel-concentrated forced flow landing on natural-inventory names
Nagel (2012), 'Evaporating Liquidity', Review of Financial Studies 25(6) - supplier withdrawal in the terminal liquidity regime
event_availability_semantics: Binding availability statements (P-1/P-3 discipline). (1) DEATH FILING + LABEL: both the filing date and the recorded form type (15-12B / 15-12G) are fixed at the filing; filing dates are date-only evidence with availability = end of the filed UTC day; per the frozen PIT gate a filing dated D may influence decisions no earlier than the first session strictly after D - the label therefore never arrives before its filing and is never backdated. (2) PRICES: EODHD bars readable at session close + 1 session; decisions use bars through t-1 for bands/eligibility. (3) ACTIVE-SERIES FILTER: computed from each name's own bars, known in real time; never requires future bars. (4) REGIME HISTORY: expanding-window terciles from already-realized decision values only. (5) SERIES-END: knowable only after the last bar; never conditioned on in advance; held names exit at last recorded close. (6) NO POST-SERIES PRICES anywhere in any arm. (7) LABEL AUTHORITY: the form-type label is read from the frozen census (P0a) as recorded EDGAR metadata; the census's own caveat that labels are 'never trusted' for death classification is carried explicitly, and the label-swap control is the preregistered test of whether the label carries tradeable reason content.
pit_observable_with_availability_semanti: Inputs: frozen death_census.json (per-CIK earliest covered-common filing with its recorded form_type_recorded; filings table carries the 12B/12G labels for all 3,395 enumerated accessions), p0d_v9_integrity_scan.json (1,550 DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED with delta structure: 1,349 of 1,550 series end on/before the filing, median delta -11 days - the reason the event clock is conservative-later), and the sha-pinned staged EODHD series for the dead leg. Clock citation rule satisfied via 'the price leg' branch of p3_invariants_freeze.json v9_additions.dead_leg_clock_funding.citing_rule - no fundamentals clock (of the 154 evaluated or 56 funded) is cited. All conditioner inputs are Phase-P frozen evidence plus real-time price facts; no scored return exists at proposal time.
aggregation_declaration: none - the conditioner is a within-cohort event count split by the evidenced form-type label; no panel-field aggregation, no PIT fundamentals vintage selection

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.universe: DEAD leg only: the 1,550 DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED cohort members. The 410 ALIVE_EVIDENCED leg is never held, ranked or conditioned. No survivorship re-substitution.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.eligibility: identical to SFV9-A6-H1 (same book machinery, different conditioner): >= 63 bars through the decision session (history floor only), band C or better (ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD at decision), RAW close >= 1.00 USD. Measured structure-only eligible populations per decision: fold 1 = 315-447 (median 364), fold 2 = 173-365 (median 281), fold 3 = 0-145 (median 73; one zero-eligible decision, 2025-07-14, abstains).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.how_the_63_bar_floor_applies_to_final_se: The floor is a HISTORY floor through the decision session; a name may enter at its 63rd bar and exit at its last close one session later; exits require only the last recorded close, which exists by definition. No forward bar requirement exists anywhere in the family.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.clock: decision grid = inherited V8 grid (per-fold local indices 63 + 21k, 80 decisions); EVENT clock = evidenced death-filing dates with the conservative-later availability semantics; the label (12B/12G) is available exactly when the filing is. No calendar or fundamentals-vintage clock.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup: 63 sessions inherited grid warmup + first 10 grid decisions abstain (expanding regime history < 10 values). Measured regime path, anchor: fold 1 abstain10/L5/M6/H6 (11 scored), fold 2 L8/M4/H14 (26 scored), fold 3 L27/M0/H0 (27 scored) - 64 scored decisions; long-leg 40 / short-leg 20 (fold-3 all-long by the declared 12B-extinction asymmetry).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding: one decision to the next (21 sessions); MID abstain closes the book at the next decision's fill; series deaths exit at last recorded close (frozen semantics); forced flat at fold boundaries with cost.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.fills: next allowed session, close-to-close, no same-session fill; frozen fill-check (a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = order does not exist).

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: SFV9-A6-H2-ANCHOR: P63(t) (12B count - 12G count, trailing 63 global sessions, active-series deaths only) expanding-tercile regime book; HIGH short / LOW long / MID abstain; measured regimes above.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour_mechanism: SFV9-A6-H2-NEIGHBOUR: identical machinery with a 126-global-session window (P126 = B126 - G126). Intended profile: positively correlated regime assignment with the anchor (expected Spearman 0.4-0.7) and smoother regimes; positive weaker expectancy supports the channel mechanism at a slower half-life; a sign flip marks horizon fragility and downweights the family regardless of the anchor. Neighbour_mechanism_support required.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.causal_negative_control: SFV9-A6-H2-CONTROL: LABEL-SWAP - the conditioner computed with the 15-12B and 15-12G labels exchanged (P63_swapped = G63 - B63, the EXACT negation of the anchor conditioner), same regime machinery, same book. It preserves the event stream, the timing, the window and every cost/eligibility property while destroying exactly the reason content the taxonomy mechanism claims is load-bearing; under the negation the control's regimes are the anchor's mirror image, making this a preregistered pure SIGN test of the channel mapping. It is RUNNABLE under evidenced semantics by construction (same filings, same availability stamps, same book machinery - it can never abort on data semantics; forex V3 lesson honored). Gate: |control alpha| < 0.5 x |anchor alpha|. Ex-ante honest expectation: if the anchor earns X from channel structure, the control earns approximately -X; if the control instead earns >= 0.5 x |anchor alpha| with the anchor's sign - i.e. the sign is arbitrary - or outperforms a negative anchor, the family is falsified per the frozen rule without argument.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.secondary_placebo: label permutation within the stream: the 1,246 active-series labels randomly permuted across events (fixed ex-ante seed, 100 permutations) destroying label-event association while preserving the label marginal counts; the anchor's regime path must separate from the permutation distribution. Runnable: touches only the conditioner string, never the data semantics.

incremental_alpha_test: Frozen factor_and_benchmark contract: arm return minus risk-matched SPY context per fold and overall (gate: overall > 0, >= 2 folds positive); equal-weight sector ETF total return as optional sector factor with ETF-share gate <= 0.35. The book is single-sided per regime (net +/-1.0 invested): the 12G-dominant long book (40 of 60 scored anchor decisions) is the dominant beta exposure and the alpha gates are named ex ante as the family's most likely binding constraints; a consideration-capture long that is only beta will fail them, and should. PnL booked after band-aware base costs in all alpha computations.
base_and_stress_costs: Frozen liquidity-band model: A 10 / B 15 / C 25 bps per side base; stress = 2x; charged exactly once per side per fill; band per ADV63 at the relevant session (PIT); book-weighted base cost measured 16.5-19.4 bps/side across the 80 grid decisions. WHERE THE BAND FLOOR CANNOT APPLY - terminal exits: a held name may end its series in band D (terminal ADV63 < 2,000,000); eligibility cannot exclude a held name and the frozen schedule defines no D rate. PREREGISTERED ALTERNATIVE: terminal exit fills with resolved band D are costed at the C rate (25/50 bps) as the conservative ceiling; under the L-I3 fail-closed kernel the resolution is computed explicitly - the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden; names with < 63 bars at their last session (3 in the dead leg) resolve at their own final band via the same rule. Entry fills never hit band D (band-D names are ineligible at decision).
turnover_and_sample_floor: 80 grid decisions; measured scored decisions: anchor 64 (11/26/27), neighbour and label-swap control computed by the identical machinery (regime counts recorded at scoring; each arm abstains/holds per its own conditioner path and all are expected in the 50-70 scored range given the measured stream - every arm's regime path is deterministic from the frozen census and re-derivable before any scoring). All arms are expected comfortably above the frozen minimums (>= 30 scored decisions overall, >= 5 per fold, >= 1 non-CASH leg per scored decision). Regime flips route through MID (~2.0 two-way per flip); annualized two-way turnover expected well under the 6.0 ceiling; both raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
drop_one_design: (1) drop-one-symbol (max contribution); (2) drop-one-fold (min over folds > 0); (3) channel robustness: rerun excluding the single largest P63 window's decisions (the most 12B-dominant stretch, expected in fold 1/2) to verify the family is not one channel-episode; survival iff after-drop expectancy > 0. All reruns inherit identical eligibility, band costs, fill clock and dead-name exit semantics.

failure_interpretation.anchor_negative_and_control_negative: the channel taxonomy carries no tradable terminal-leg structure - REJECT with margin-to-fail per gate (P-2).
failure_interpretation.label_swap_reproduces_or_outruns: the sign of the channel mapping is arbitrary (or the label is pure noise): family FALSIFIED per the frozen causal_control_rule - this is the preregistered fate if the caveat bites; recorded, never rescued.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_only_via_fold_3_long: no 12B-side evidence in-window (fold-3 is all-12G by the declared asymmetry): channel-unvalidated, downweighted, NOT promotable on folds 1-2's behalf (preregistered in falsifiable_prediction).
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_alpha_negative: consideration-capture long book is beta: exposure form, REJECT (long-SPY-dressing veto).
failure_interpretation.only_fold_2_positive: 2021-2022 channel episode, not a persistent mechanism.
failure_interpretation.anchor_positive_all_gates: continue to Stage-A on the preregistered parameters only; margin-to-fail reported per gate.

source_to_test_map.inputs: death_census.json (filings table with recorded form types; per-CIK earliest covered-common filing) + p0d_v9_integrity_scan.json + staged sha-pinned EODHD series (p0d_v9_price_manifest.json) + p3_invariants_freeze.json (folds, floors, band model, dead-name book semantics) + p2_v9_coverage_first.json (price-leg servability facts).
source_to_test_map.pipeline: label and availability-stamp the frozen event stream -> active-series filter -> P63/P126 counters at each inherited grid decision -> expanding tercile regimes (+ label-swap mirror) -> eligibility + bands (bars through t-1) -> one-sided equal-weight book -> next-session fills with fill-check -> exit-at-last-close for series deaths -> band-aware costs with the preregistered band-D terminal resolution -> folds -> Stage-A gates + label-swap control + label-permutation placebo + channel-episode drop-one + stress rerun.
source_to_test_map.not_touched: pit_conditioning.py; no SEC fundamentals field; no funded fundamentals clock cited.

dead_name_book_semantics_compliance: Identical compliance statement to SFV9-A6-H1: every arm runs under the preregistered dead-name book semantics (63-bar + band eligibility, fill-check, exit-at-last-close carrying the delisting-return leg, no synthetic continuation, no survivorship re-substitution); no arm requires prices after any series' last bar.
infeasibility_declarations: Same design-time drops as SFV9-A6-H1, measured structure-only: (1) post-Form-15 continuation entry infeasible (201 names with post-filing bars; 25 events after inherited floors, fold 1 = 3 < 5; 49 band-only, fold 1 still 3; short continuations, median 9 bars; merger-print dominated) - below the frozen book minimums under both eligibility readings. (2) OTC tails unservable (1,349/1,550 series end on/before the filing; median delta -11 days; probe evidence: dead series end at exact death sessions) - any post-termination-price mechanism dropped. (3) Realized delisting-return magnitude as a conditioner is look-ahead - magnitude enters only as the outcome of exit-at-last-close; the ex-ante ADV63 band partition is recorded for stratified reporting only. (4) ADDITIONAL TO THIS FAMILY: no mechanism may use the census's UNCLASSIFIED buckets (405 filings) or non-cohort filers' events (513 GAP_COVERAGE names, 19 NOT_DEAD_NAME_ALIVE) as conditioner mass - the stream is cohort deaths only, and the label caveat means no arm treats the label as a validated discriminator, only as a conditioner tested by its own control.
margin_to_fail_expectations: Ex ante per the inherited Stage-A gate table: expectancy_gt - coin-flip ex ante; the reason-bimodality effect must clear 18.4 bps/side base; a small negative on failure (order -1e-4/decision) is expected rather than large. position_pf_ge (1.1) - binding if the mechanism is real but thin; expected margin < 0.1. folds_positive_ge (2/3) - fold 1 carries only 11 scored decisions and the warmup; most likely single-fold failure. max_fold_mdd_le (0.15) - HIGH RISK: 40/64 anchor decisions are long-side ±1.0 books; a 12G-dominant long leg overlapping a market drawdown (2023-2024 windows are 12G-dominant by the declared asymmetry) is the most likely MDD breach. risk_matched_excess_positive_folds_ge / anchor_overall_alpha_gt / etf_positive_share_le - HIGH RISK by design: the long-heavy book must beat beta, and this proposal predicts that as the honest crucible. control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt (0.5) - the label-swap control is the family's core risk: it is an exact-negation sign test, and the preregistered commitment is that a sign-arbitrary result kills the family without argument. drop_one - channel-episode robustness is the bind most likely to fire (one 12B episode must not be the family). stress (2x) - HIGH RISK if base margin is thin (P-2). decision-count floors - PASS by measured construction (anchor 64 scored; sibling arms 50-70 expected, deterministic from the frozen census). reproduction ALL_MATCH - required process gate.
novelty_declaration: vs SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE: no calendar cycle anywhere; the conditioner is the evidenced channel composition of a death stream that no prior cycle possessed. vs SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL and momentum ancestry: no return observable is ranked; direction is an event-count regime. vs SFV4 ancestry: no volume or variance signal; the control is a conditioner negation, structurally distinct from the stale-rank inversion. vs SFV8-F1/F2: no fundamentals field; different information set and mechanism class; D2 measures |rho| <= 0.20 vs both anchors and both shadows. vs sibling SFV9-A6-H1 (same lane): H1 asks whether death ARRIVAL TIMING carries terminal-leg information (control: stale timing); H2 asks whether death CHANNEL CONTENT carries it (control: label swap) - the two anchors share book machinery but their conditioners are different functions of the stream (count vs signed type difference), their controls fail them on different axes, and H2 alone carries the reason-bimodality hypothesis; the shared machinery is declared for cost/control comparability, not hidden. vs lane A4/A5: no distress rank, no fundamentals clock.
